# Main component — Fireside firmware for the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B.
#
# ui/*.c are generated by EEZ Studio (Ctrl+B on the .eez-project). Every
# ui_font_*.c and ui_image_*.c the export emits gets swept in via GLOB.
# The core files (screens.c / styles.c / images.c / ui.c) only exist AFTER
# the export runs — before that, the __has_include guards in main.c and
# other files collapse the UI symbols to placeholders so the project still
# links to a boot-clean state.
file(GLOB UI_FONT_SRCS "audio.c" "main.c" "actions.c" "sd_config.c" "vars.c" "ui/ui_font_*.c")
file(GLOB UI_IMAGE_SRCS "ui/ui_image_*.c")
file(GLOB UI_CORE_SRCS "ui/screens.c" "ui/styles.c" "ui/images.c" "ui/ui.c")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        main.c
        actions.c
        vars.c
        app_state.c
        alarms.c
        audio.c
        audio_assets.c
        battery.c
        perf.c
        wifi_health.c
        sd_config.c
        discovery.c
        ${UI_CORE_SRCS}
        ${UI_FONT_SRCS}
        ${UI_IMAGE_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        .
        ui
    REQUIRES
        # Waveshare BSP — bundles esp_lcd_ek79007, esp_lcd_touch_gt911,
        # esp_lvgl_port, esp_codec_dev(ES8311 + ES7210), and the SD/SPIFFS
        # helpers.
        waveshare__esp32_p4_wifi6_touch_lcd_7b
        # Thin compatibility shim so shared vars.c / actions.c can call
        # set_lcd_blight() without knowing about the Waveshare BSP.
        bsp_shim
        # LVGL — pinned to 8.4 to match the .eez-project's lvglVersion.
        lvgl__lvgl
        espressif__esp_lvgl_port
        # Codec dev API used directly by main/audio.c.
        espressif__esp_codec_dev
        # Fireside connectivity stack (local components/).
        wifi_setup mqtt_client fireside_config button_config
        # Push-to-talk voice terminal client (local components/).
        peregrine_voice
        # WiFi over ESP-Hosted (C6 coprocessor on SDIO).
        espressif__esp_hosted
        # IDF stack.
        esp_wifi esp_netif esp_event esp_timer nvs_flash json
        esp_app_format app_update esp_partition
        # HTTP client — peregrine_voice pulls this in via its own REQUIRES
        # but list it here too so main can #include esp_http_client.h if
        # needed for other integrations (currently not, but future-proof).
        esp_http_client
        # Discovery: mDNS advert + HTTP server on port 80 so Headwaters can
        # locate and confirm this module (see main/discovery.c).
        esp_http_server
        espressif__mdns
    PRIV_REQUIRES
        # ADC driver used by battery.c (voltage divider on GPIO 20).
        esp_adc
        esp_driver_gpio
        # FATFS + SDMMC — sd_config.c reads /sdcard/environment.conf via
        # bsp_sdcard_mount (Waveshare BSP wraps esp_vfs_fat_sdmmc_mount).
        fatfs
        sdmmc
)

target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    MODULE_TYPE="fireside"
)

# At -O2 (CONFIG_COMPILER_OPTIMIZATION_PERF) GCC's range analysis flags
# a dozen `char buf[8]` sites in vars.c / actions.c whose values are
# physically bounded (percent 0-100, small temperatures). snprintf still
# truncates safely at runtime; this demotes the compile-time error only.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wno-format-truncation)

# LVGL simple header include — matches every other TrailCurrent EEZ project.
idf_component_get_property(LVGL_LIB lvgl__lvgl COMPONENT_LIB)
if(LVGL_LIB)
    target_compile_options(${LVGL_LIB} PRIVATE
        -DLV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)
endif()
